summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests pass (after updating 1 iteration-1 test to expect new admin-auth behavior on GET /api/contact). All new endpoints (bookings, leads, resources CRUD, admin auth) work correctly. Frontend: all 8 new flows verified — Contact tabbed UI (Booking default + switching), BookingWidget end-to-end (day/slot pickers + submit + confirmation panel), Resources page lists 3 seeded items with GATED badges on the right two, ResourceDetail gated flow (LeadGate -> submit -> unlock + localStorage persistence across reload), dpdp-readiness shows body without gate, SEO meta + JSON-LD (Organization on every page, Article + BreadcrumbList on resource detail), mobile 390px viewport responsive. Minor SEO gap: service category pages have Service + BreadcrumbList but FAQPage schema is missing (spec asked for Service+FAQPage+BreadcrumbList). Deeper service slug pages (e.g., /services/cybersecurity/penetration-testing) appear not implemented — title falls back to default and only Organization schema present.

minor.issue: Returns 200 on create; REST convention is 201. Same pattern across /contact, /newsletter, /careers/apply, /leads, /resources (non-blocking).
No EmailStr-uniqueness or rate-limit; same email can spam-submit. Not blocking for MVP but flag for production.

Field alias 'readTime' is accepted on input (good), but list/get endpoints expose snake_case 'read_time' (Pydantic default). Frontend already handles both (`r.read_time || r.readTime`). Consistent serialization with by_alias=True would be cleaner.
Returns 503 if ADMIN_API_KEY is empty rather than 401; acceptable but document so ops doesn't accidentally ship without the env var.

issues: FAQPage JSON-LD schema is NOT present — spec required Service + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList. Currently only Service + BreadcrumbList + Organization are emitted.

Route appears to fall back to the home page — title becomes the default 'Cybersecurity, Compliance & Deep Tech Consulting — Datamosh Technologies LLP' and only Organization JSON-LD is present. Either the route is not registered or per-page SEO is not wired for sub-service slugs. Verify whether nested service slugs are intended in iteration 2 scope.

action_items: Add FAQPage JSON-LD schema to service category pages via faqSchema() helper (already exists in SEO.jsx) — pass faqs array on each /services/:slug page to satisfy spec.

Confirm whether nested service slugs (e.g., /services/cybersecurity/penetration-testing) are in scope. If yes, register routes and wire SEO; if no, ensure unknown paths redirect to /services rather than falling through to home with wrong title.
(Optional/minor) Switch POST creates to return 201 across the board for REST consistency.
(Optional/minor) Add basic rate-limiting / dedupe on POST /api/leads to prevent spam unlocks.
Document ADMIN_API_KEY rotation procedure — current key is in .env and prefixed 'change_me'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean Pydantic v2 models with ConfigDict(extra='ignore'); Mongo _id correctly projected out everywhere ({'_id': 0}); good async/await usage throughout.
Startup seeding is idempotent (checks count==0) — safe for restarts.
Admin auth via simple x-admin-key header is fine for MVP. For production: rotate via env, consider HMAC + IP allow-list or move to Bearer/JWT.

BookingWidget: day chips computed via nextBusinessDays() — uses local timezone for fmtDate via toISOString which converts to UTC, may cause off-by-one for users near IDL or late-night IST. Minor — flag only.

ResourceDetailPage: localStorage key well-scoped ('datamosh.unlocked.resources'). Note that unlock can be bypassed via devtools — acceptable for soft gating, but server-side guard would be needed for true paywall.

SEO.jsx: clean, helper functions are exported and used correctly; Organization JSON-LD always included. Single concern: image-only seo prop overrides og:image, which is fine — but twitter:image also uses same `og` var (good).
